name: FoomLottery Groth16 degenerate-verifier proof forgery
summary: The Groth16 verifier was deployed with gamma and delta set to the same BN254 G2 generator point because the snarkjs Phase 2 contribution was skipped, collapsing proof soundness so anyone can forge withdrawal proofs for fresh nullifiers with C equal to negated vk_x. The anchor creates the exploit contract and loops forged collect calls against the Base lottery; sixteen minutes later the same flaw was exercised against the Ethereum lottery and those proceeds were returned the same day.
notes: The verifier is an immutable direct contract whose runtime is byte-identical at deployment and pre-exploit and contains zero DELEGATECALL opcodes. The degenerate gamma-equals-delta verification key is baked in from creation, so deployment is the age reset.

Gross pre-recovery victim depletion across both chains: 4,588,196,709,631.799956807157941481 FOOM leaves the Base lottery in the anchor and 19,695,576,757,802.192910518134117126 FOOM leaves the Ethereum lottery in the rescue transaction, together about 24.28T FOOM reported at $2.26M. The $1.84M whitehat return executed hours later is not netted out. FOOM is illiquid and realized disposals cleared at discounts, so the USD splits are reported estimates; duha retains the Base share under a disputed bounty claim.
The $2.26M headline and per-chain USD splits are reported estimates over an illiquid token whose disposals cleared at discounts; the structured FOOM quantities are exact onchain.
